coverage_gaps: Only PubMed is available, so trial registries, preprint servers, regulatory databases, patent and chemistry sources, citation graphs, and DOI metadata services cannot be searched directly.

Forward-citation coverage and records absent from PubMed may be missed; PubMed-linked references, similar articles, and review bibliographies can support limited expansion but cannot replace a dedicated citation graph.
The route constraint prevents independent verification of retraction status, regulatory actions, unpublished negative findings, and ongoing studies outside PubMed.

Physiological-substrate evidence may be sensitive to tissue, cell type, stimulation state, assay, and inhibitor selectivity, so absence from this retrieval plan cannot establish absence of phosphorylation in vivo.
exclusion_criteria: Records focused on unrelated LRRK family proteins without separable LRRK2 evidence.
Studies mentioning LRRK2 or Parkinson disease only incidentally and providing no decision-relevant genetic, mechanistic, substrate, physiological, or limiting evidence.
Purely in silico predictions lacking experimental or human genetic validation, except when used solely to locate a testable primary evidence trail.
Non-biomedical commentary, news, conference-only records without sufficient methods or results, and duplicate publications lacking additional evidence.

Mechanism claims supported only by overexpression or nonphysiological assay conditions when no endogenous, genetic, pharmacological, or orthogonal validation is reported; such records may be retained only as explicitly weak evidence.
inclusion_criteria: PubMed-indexed records published on or before 2024-12-31 that directly address LRRK2 genetics, enzymology, substrates, cellular physiology, or Parkinson disease relevance.
Primary human genetic studies reporting linkage, segregation, association, ancestry, prevalence, penetrance, or variant-specific clinical observations.
Biochemical, structural, cellular, tissue, patient-derived, or animal studies that directly test LRRK2 kinase or Roc-COR GTPase function and identify or validate substrates.
Studies supporting endogenous or physiological substrate status through genetic perturbation, selective pharmacology, phosphosite measurement, tissue evidence, or orthogonal validation.
Null, negative, contradictory, replication, correction, retraction, incomplete-penetrance, and population-limitation evidence relevant to the proposed mechanism.
Reviews may be retained for terminology, historical orientation, and backward reference discovery, while mechanistic claims require verification against primary records.
All languages are eligible when PubMed supplies enough English metadata to assess relevance or the full report can be interpreted.

question_frame: Target-mechanism frame: from PubMed inception through 2024-12-31, identify peer-reviewed human genetic, biochemical, structural, cellular, and animal evidence connecting LRRK2 to Parkinson disease; trace genetic discovery and disease-associated variants, define kinase and Roc-COR GTPase mechanisms and endogenous physiological substrates, and retrieve penetrance, population-specific, null, contradictory, replication, correction, and retraction evidence that constrains causal strength or generalizability.
stop_rules: Complete all twelve planned PubMed query events and preserve each exact query-to-record link before deduplication.
Confirm that sentinel retrieval recovers early LRRK2 genetic-discovery records and foundational Rab-substrate records; expand aliases and rerun affected waves if either anchor class is absent.
Apply the 2024-12-31 publication cutoff after retrieval whenever PubMed indexing or online-first dates are ambiguous.
Deduplicate canonical records by PMID and DOI while preserving every query occurrence and flagging conflicting metadata for manual resolution.
Continue targeted expansion until two consecutive expansion passes add no new decision-relevant variant, enzymatic mechanism, physiological substrate, or limiting-evidence category.
Stop when every requested evidence domain has at least one screened primary evidence trail and challenge searching yields no unresolved high-impact contradictory claim within the twelve-event budget.
If the query-event budget is reached with unresolved domains or contradictions, stop and report budget exhaustion and the affected domains rather than silently broadening the plan.
